_comments.comparison: All three runs use the same 10-epoch budget, seed-42 defaults, RoPE encoder, memory-trunk decoder, 32-dimensional latents, K-means codebook initialization, and otherwise resolved dataclass defaults.
_comments.adaptive: Adaptive warmup keeps the default min_steps=1000, check_every=200, patience=5, dim_tolerance=1, probe_points=8192, and variance_threshold=0.99, with a 6000-step hard cap.
_comments.double_l2: The second run L2-normalizes encoder latents before VQ and normalizes vectors used by VQ distance and EMA codebook updates.
_comments.baseline: The baseline has no AE warmup; with the default K-means initialization it initializes the codebook before the first VQ optimizer step.
